purpose.zh: 专练最后锁直膝盖的力量
purpose.en: Train the last bit of knee straightening.

text.zh: 用力把膝锁直，大腿前侧绷紧
text.en: Straighten your knee fully and tighten the front of your thigh

text.zh: 弹力带套在膝后，微屈膝开始
text.en: Loop the band behind your knee and start with a slight bend.
Hold straight for two seconds without lifting your heel.

commonErrors.zh: 只是挺髋，膝没有完全伸直
commonErrors.en: Pushing the hips forward without fully straightening the knee.

cautions.zh: 膝盖疼痛时减轻阻力，仍痛就停止
cautions.en: Use a lighter band if your knee hurts, and stop if the pain continues.
